text: ADVERSARIAL QA — CONFIRMED DEFECT (owner: contract.ts / MAIN+s3, do NOT let me second-write it). A malformed assisted-order submission that OMITS a nested object 500s as "service temporarily unavailable" instead of a clean 4xx. Three shapes: missing contact, missing contact.shippingAddress, missing contact.billingAddress when billingSameAsShipping=false. Root cause: shared/research/assisted-order/contract.ts validateSubmitInput()/validateAddress() dereference input.contact.email / input.line1 BEFORE checking the object is present; normalizeRequiredText(undefined) would throw the right 400 but undefined.line1 throws a raw TypeError first, which the express adapter maps to 500. A missing SUB-field (postalCode) is a correct 400 — only the whole object crashes. Severity MEDIUM (fail-closed: no order, no write, no notification) — it is robustness/observability, not money or disclosure: a 4xx client mistake shown to the customer as an outage + logged as a 5xx. Fix = one presence guard per deref (throw AssistedOrderValidationError). Live reproduction committed on xenios/launch-integration-20260819: e2e/malformed-submission-5xx.spec.ts (it.fails tripwires — they go RED when you fix contract.ts, that red = delete the file and fold the 3 cases into submission-validation-negatives.spec.ts). Also added e2e/submission-validation-negatives.spec.ts: 22 passing door negatives (zero/negative/fractional/string/null qty, empty+duplicate lines, empty/stale/partial agreements, age gate, anonymous, each missing shipping sub-field) — all correct, now locked at the composed HTTP door. Full e2e: 51 pass + 3 expected-fail. Rest of the founder attack matrix (price/variant/action tamper, Care/pending/held/GRP-0422/capsule bypass, qty ceiling, affiliate self-verify, duplicate/replay/race, IDOR, notif-dup, price leakage) verified COVERED. Cross-member idempotency reviewed: keyed on hash(email+key) with full-contact fingerprint — not exploitable without already holding the victim PII + secret key.
